# Divya Admission Hub

> Divya Admission Hub is an academic admission consultancy in Dayalpur, Delhi specializing in NIOS 10th & 12th open schooling admissions, IGNOU distance degrees, and direct university admissions for B.Ed and D.Pharma.

## Core Educational Services

- [NIOS Class 10th & 12th Admissions](https://divya-admission-hub.vercel.app/programs): Full registration and counseling for NIOS Secondary and Senior Secondary boards, Transfer of Credit (TOC), and On-Demand Examinations.
- [IGNOU Distance Degrees](https://divya-admission-hub.vercel.app/programs): Undergraduate and postgraduate distance education guidance for BA, B.Com, BCA, MCA, and MBA degrees.
- [Direct Professional Degree Admissions](https://divya-admission-hub.vercel.app/programs): Direct enrollment assistance for B.Ed, DIET/JBT, D.Pharma, and B.Pharma in approved institutions.
- [About Divya Admission Hub](https://divya-admission-hub.vercel.app/about): Founder background, accreditation support, and academic credentials.
- [Academic Counseling & Support](https://divya-admission-hub.vercel.app/support): Reach out via phone (+91 8178056407) or visit the Dayalpur center in Delhi.
